text: How would you structure error handling so all API errors share a consistent response envelope?
answer_outline: Register exception handlers for validation, HTTP, and unhandled errors; return a uniform {status, error} shape; avoid leaking internals on 500.

text: What is the difference between sync and async route handlers in FastAPI, and what can block the event loop?
answer_outline: Sync handlers run in a threadpool; async run on the event loop. CPU-bound work or blocking I/O in an async handler stalls the loop; offload to threads/executors.

text: How would you expose a long-running AI pipeline through an API without making the request unreliable?
